# Brainstem anywhere

> One file that wakes a RAPP Brainstem (your own AI as files: soul, agents, memory) inside any AI that can run
> Python, such as claude.ai. The AI becomes its model; the Brainstem's agents run in the AI's sandbox.

## Use it
1. Download the file: https://kody-w.github.io/brainstem-anywhere/versions/brainstem/685e0ec68df9.py (sha256 685e0ec68df9c42217f654fcd9c63d8f68ab26e19311f85f9e25e1459a55b700)
2. Attach it in your AI and say: "Wake this Brainstem using the instructions at the top of the file. You are its model. Pass everything I say to it and show me its exact reply. When I say I'm done, hand me my Brainstem back as one file."
3. When done, the AI hands back ONE file (`host take-home brainstem-home.py`): this Brainstem now, memory and chat.
   At home: `python3 brainstem-home.py`. (Or with a chat.json: `python3 brainstem.py --home chat.json`.) Import
   continues the chat in the page.

## API
- https://kody-w.github.io/brainstem-anywhere/api/v1/brainstem.json  (schema brainstem-anywhere-brainstem/1.0): latest file, hash, agents, sentence
- https://kody-w.github.io/brainstem-anywhere/registry.json  (schema brainstem-anywhere-registry/1.0): every version, append-only under versions/
- https://kody-w.github.io/brainstem-anywhere/api/v1/status.json

## Made from
- Brainstem kernel (unchanged): https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-installer @ 0e43ee580e78c150b1c59002456822d2e779388e
